The capital Ts should use the same straight wide top bar, stem thickness and geometry as the capital T in There; uppercase S should use the same shape and weight as the capital S in Studio. No border, no tile shadow, no additional symbols, no full brand name, no period, no gradients, no texture, no presentation board. One favicon only.
